pages.text: $(li)For modular machines, AE2 with a Level Emitter on a small subnet is easier than XNet: it supports parallel multiblocks per recipe type and avoids timing pitfalls.$(li)ME hatches can lag badly because they ping AE2 for every craft request;

standard hatches are the safe choice for autocrafting.$(li)For multi-recipe MMCE multis (e.g., Enchanted Greenhouse), rely on output hatch overflow: full slots automatically skip to the next recipe with space.

$(li)Enchanted Greenhouse input hatch: items won’t auto-extract—break and replace the hatch to reset.$(li)Black hole tanks can't be inserted into a controller automatically: detect full tanks with Integrated Dynamics, and break and replace them with a placer when empty.
$(li)Rotate Modular Machine Controllers with a Crescent Hammer; rotate previews by right-clicking the controller after building.
